title: Grok CLI Agent Backend
desc: Spec and verification contract for connecting the official xAI Grok CLI to Agent.cmd and wkhippo.
steps: CLI: The official headless form is grok -p PROMPT. Authenticate from XAI_API_KEY in D:/GitHub/.env, prove grok -p reply PONG, and preserve the exact reply as test evidence without exposing credentials. //why:install sector dispatched to prove grok headless today //why:install sector dispatched to prove grok headless today-opus

SPEC: Connect the official xAI grok CLI to WKAppBot in three increments: install and prove a headless call, add an Agent.cmd --model grok backend with fake and live tests, then read ~/.grok/sessions into wkhippo rows for user, token usage, model changes, and skill reads. Keep the API key sourced only from D:/GitHub/.env and never print it.

BACKEND: Add bin/AgentBackend.grok.ps1 and a --model grok route beside the muse-code route in the existing model map. Support WK_GROK_CMD for a fake binary inversion test, then run one live call through the real CLI.

READER: Add a wkhippo Grok session reader for ~/.grok/sessions. Emit rows for user turns, token usage, model changes, and skill reads, and test an inversion fixture that must reject unrelated session files. //why:grok updates jsonl shapes measured and reader sector dispatched //why:grok updates jsonl shapes measured and reader sector dispatched-opus

MEASURED 2026-10-10 (spokesman dcb47781): grok 1.0.50 installs by downloading https://x.ai/cli/install.ps1 to .tmp and running it by path (an irm pipe to iex is refused), binary ~/.grok/bin/grok.exe, key from XAI_API_KEY. Grok AUTO-LOADS CLAUDE.md as project rules and its README names vendor-compat hooks, but an empty-folder probe (sector 2026-10-10) found NO hook execution in ~/.grok/logs/unified.jsonl and no harness stop log, so the hook theory is UNPROVEN; what is proven: grok kept going for minutes after printing PONG and wrote a FABRICATED report in the CLAUDE.md reply form (Reflex-healing paragraph, evidence lines), i.e. it imitates the project rules it loads (claimed it fixed and pushed Get-WkDescentPassState.ps1; origin and the working tree were unchanged). SPEC: the grok identity signal is the env var GROK_SESSION_ID (also GROK_AGENT), set by grok in every tool shell and absent from claude (measured 2026-10-10; fallback parent process grok.exe); the harness family detector maps it to family grok, and Agent.cmd --model grok prefixes the brief with one line telling grok to answer the task only, with no Reflex-healing or evidence paragraphs, because grok loads CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md as rules (README lines 1554-1566) and copies their reply form, and Agent.cmd --model grok must treat any claim of a commit as unverified until git show origin proves it; never disable the hooks to get a clean reply, because they are the only guard on its file writes. //why:measured env signal chosen for grok family detection //why:grok vendor hooks found, identity probe sector running //why:grok vendor hooks found, identity probe sector running-opus //why:measured env signal chosen for grok family detection-opus
ACCEPTANCE: Each increment has a proto and self-test under .tmp, passes its inversion case, is landed separately, and reports the commit hash plus canonical-path rerun.
